description: Erection of a part single storey side extension incorporating front porch and associated internal alterations. Extension of first floor rear roof terrace
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed enlargement to the rear roof terrace would, owing to its bulky and incongruous design, increased proximity to neighbouring dwellings/rear gardens and associated loss of an important design feature of the original Grade II Listed building, cause harm to the character and appearance of the Listed Building and wider Bedford Park Conservation Area and result in an increased degree of overlooking and resultant loss of privacy which would cause harm to the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers. The application is therefore contrary to Local Plan policies CC1, CC2, CC4 and SC7 and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines SPD and Bedford Park Conservation Area Appraisal.

Condition : 2 - The proposed side extension, due to the design, would result in significant harm to the character and appearance of the host property, thereby failing to preserve and enhance the Conservation Area. It is therefore not considered to comply with adopted Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture), CC4 (Heritage) and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations).
